purpose: Resolve whether the residual PQ accessory labels correspond to distinct canonical accessory inventory identities, without converting clothing/set rewards into accessories.

records.name: Android 14's Hat
evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 Equipment documentation lists Android 14's Clothes as clothing-set item 123 and gives Parallel Quest 104 as its source; it does not list a separately named Android 14's Hat accessory.
An independent equipment guide likewise maps PQ104 to Android 14's Clothes rather than a hat/accessory.
The repository's current equipment catalog contains Android 14's Clothes, but no exact Android 14's Hat canonical accessory identity was established.
records.evidence_boundary: PQ104 establishes Android 14's Clothes, not a distinct Android 14's Hat accessory. No canonical acc-### or equipment-accessory endpoint should be created from the clothing reward.

records.name: Bardock (DB Super)'s Scouter
evidence: Current PQ146 reward documentation lists Bardock (DB Super)'s Clothes, Thunder Flash, and Destructive Fission among the rewards; it does not list a Bardock (DB Super)'s Scouter accessory.
A maintained Xenoverse 2 equipment/clothing reference independently maps PQ146 to Bardock (DB Super)'s Clothes.
Current equipment/ID evidence identifies Bardock (DB Super)'s Clothes as an outfit item; generic Scouter inventory entries are not evidence that a Bardock-specific scouter exists.
records.evidence_boundary: PQ146 establishes Bardock (DB Super)'s Clothes, not a separately named Bardock (DB Super)'s Scouter accessory. Do not map the research label to a generic Scouter color or create a canonical accessory without an exact inventory-level identity.

guardrails: Do not infer an accessory from a character clothing/set reward.
Do not map a character-specific research label to a generic inventory item solely by visual or naming similarity.
Keep the unresolved research labels and explicit evidence boundary until exact inventory-level evidence appears.
